plan.disposition: external plan/iterate review is medium+ only, this run is small complexity per the Phase Matrix

findings.finding: isSafeProbeHost's own JSDoc quoted a paraphrase of openBrowserPlan's win32 comment that this same diff had already rewritten to no longer make that claim — a stale, slightly circular cross-reference.
findings.suggestion: Reword isSafeProbeHost's JSDoc to describe the current state directly rather than paraphrasing the other comment. FIXED before merge: reworded.

findings.finding: The new CI-visible source-level regression test only checked that server/src/lib/resolveHonoHost.ts exists and exports the function by name — it did not cross-check the hardcoded dist specifier (server/dist/lib/resolveHonoHost.js) against server/tsconfig.json's actual rootDir/outDir mapping, so a future tsconfig change would silently escape this check.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that also reads server/tsconfig.json and asserts rootDir/outDir still match the assumption. FIXED before merge: added.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the dynamic cross-package import is adequately guarded against drift — the added CI-safe test only regex-matches 'export function resolveHonoHost' in the .ts source; a signature-narrowing refactor (e.g. dropping the exec=defaultExec default) still matches that regex, is invisible to bootstrapper's CI (which never builds server/), and silently regresses tailscale-profile users to the pre-fix bug.
findings.suggestion: a server-side contract/parity test pinning resolveHonoHost's call signature and return semantics. FIXED before merge: added a depth-aware test asserting every parameter after env carries a default value.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: resolveProbeHost's fallback to loopback is always benign — a transient tailscale-CLI failure on THIS invocation while a healthy incumbent is bound to a tailscale IP from an EARLIER successful resolution causes the probe to read 'free' and triggers a redundant boot attempt.
findings.suggestion: distinguish a resolution failure from 'server not running', or an explicit written rebuttal accepting the narrow window. ADDRESSED before merge: documented as an accepted trade-off in resolveProbeHost's JSDoc and the PR body (window is narrow — bounded by resolveTailscaleIp's 2s exec timeout — and reproduces only the SAME symptom the pre-fix bug always produced, now rare instead of constant); not further code-fixed, judged disproportionate machinery for the window's rarity.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: isSafeProbeHost fully characterizes what is safe to do with the resolved host — it validates shell/URL-metacharacter safety only; an explicit HONO_HOST=external-hostname now makes the bootstrapper itself issue outbound TCP+HTTP requests to that host on every launch — new egress vs. pre-fix loopback-only probing.
findings.suggestion: clarify the docstring's safety claim scope. FIXED before merge: reworded.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: the test suite proves ensureServer's onFallback-to-log wiring works — no test asserts on log output for the resolveProbeHost fallback path; the default-wiring arrow function in ensureServer is exercised only for its return value, not its log side effect.
findings.suggestion: a test passing a custom log spy through the default (unmocked resolveProbeHost) path. FIXED before merge: added.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: isSafeProbeHost's hostname branch only accepts genuine hostnames — a malformed IP-shaped string like '999.999.999.999' passes the hostname regex even though isIP correctly rejects it as an IP — harmless in practice (DNS failure reads as free, identical to pre-fix behaviour).
findings.suggestion: no action needed per the doubt-reviewer's own assessment.

external_code.disposition: external LLM code review is Advisory/freely skippable below medium per the Phase Matrix — this run is small complexity
